lines.quote: Trump's foreign policy is on the ballot this year
lines.subject: Trump's foreign policy
lit: Trump's foreign policy is on the ballot
lines.why: Frames the president's foreign policy record, including the Iran war, as a matter to be judged, which points to who is to blame rather than the reading itself.

lines.quote: starting a war with Iran
lines.subject: Trump
lit: siding with Putin, to annexing Greenland
lines.why: Lists the Iran war among the record items that the framing treats as a failure of the no-war promise.

lines.quote: whether it's lived up to his America first promises
lines.subject: Mark Hertling and MS NOW
lit: whether it's lived up to his America first promises
dig into Trump's foreign policy record
lines.why: Frames the war's record as a question about whether the no-war promise was kept, leaning toward a shortfall.

lines.quote: Iran in 'Advanced Stages' of Planning Attacks Against Americans, Officials Say
lines.subject: US officials
lit: Advanced Stages of Planning Attacks Against Americans
lines.why: Reports a dated official finding that Iranian attack planning against Americans has advanced, which worsens the war's state for the audience.

lines.quote: The U.S. government has ordered diplomats and other federal employees to leave Saudi Arabia.
lines.subject: US government
lit: ordered diplomats and other federal employees to leave Saudi Arabia
drawing down staff at other missions
lines.why: States a dated fact of evacuation orders that signals the war is escalating against Americans in the region.

lines.quote: Iran says won't allow US warships to get close as Trump ponders new attacks
lines.subject: Iranian officials
lit: won't allow US warships to get close
lines.why: Reports Iranian refusal to back down and a possible new US attack, pointing to a closer and more active war.

lines.quote: Iranian officials, media and analysts sense war is closer, but signal there will be no backing down.
lines.subject: Iranian officials, media and analysts
lit: there will be no backing down
lines.why: Describes a widening sense that war is nearing with no sign of de-escalation, which the audience would read as frustration.

lines.quote: Ticket prices jumped after fuel costs spiked because of the war with Iran
lines.subject: airlines and fares
lit: because of the war with Iran
lines.why: Names a mechanism by which the war raised fuel costs and fares, a direct cost burden on travelers.

lines.quote: even an end to the conflict will not bring fares back down quickly
lines.subject: airlines
lit: will not bring fares back down quickly
High Airfares May Be Here to Stay
lines.why: Forecasts that higher costs will persist even after the war ends, so the cost burden continues without a date.

lines.quote: US intelligence memo warns that Iranian plots against US citizens in the Middle East 'have reached advanced stages'
lines.subject: US intelligence memo
lines.why: Cites a dated intelligence warning of Iranian plots against Americans, a worsening threat state for the audience.

lines.quote: U.S. is reducing staffing at 4 Middle East embassies over increased threats from Iran
lines.subject: US government
lit: reducing staffing at 4 Middle East embassies
lines.why: States a dated government action in response to rising Iranian threats, which signals a worsening war state.

lines.quote: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said his teams 'have received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel.'
lines.subject: Jay Clayton
lit: Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel
lines.why: Records a dated intelligence finding that Iran is increasing efforts to target Americans, pointing to a worsening war.

lines.quote: Iran has 'substantially increased' efforts to target Americans abroad
lines.subject: US intelligence memo on Iran
lines.why: A dated intelligence memo reports rising Iranian threats to Americans, which cuts against the no-war promise.

lines.quote: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
lines.subject: Taiz residents, Yemen
lines.why: The line reports a humanitarian crisis in Yemen with no bearing on US audiences or the US war reading.

lines.quote: SEAL Team 6 Operator Recounts The Full Mission That Led To Osama Bin Laden's Death
lines.subject: Rob O'Neill, podcast host and guest
lines.why: The post is a show promo about a past raid and does not measure the Iran war or the economy.

lines.quote: Global Oil Price Hits $116 a Barrel, Highest Since April
lines.subject: global oil market
lines.why: A dated Brent price at a seven-month high raises costs for American buyers.

lines.quote: investors have grown increasingly concerned that the war in Iran could escalate again
lines.subject: investors
lit: concerned that the war in Iran
putting energy supplies at greater risk
lines.why: The line links renewed escalation to energy supply risk, a mechanism that would frustrate the audience if it happens.

lines.quote: Rubio urges Cubans to work with CIA to bring political change to communist-run island
lines.subject: Marco Rubio
lit: urges Cubans to work with CIA
Trump floated sending him to Cuba
lines.why: The line describes a Cuba policy push by a named official and does not measure the Iran war reading.

lines.quote: Trump at GOP rally in Florida revives idea of military intervention in Cuba after Iran
lines.subject: Donald Trump
lit: revives idea of military intervention in Cuba
lines.why: Reviving another intervention after Iran signals more war, which the audience's no-war promise would not welcome.

lines.quote: U.S. warships returning from the Middle East could stop over in Cuba on their way back from the Iran war
lines.subject: US warships, Trump
lit: warships returning from the Middle East
on their way back from the Iran war
lines.why: The line places US forces still returning from an ongoing Iran war, a fact that runs against the no-war promise.

lines.quote: The president’s instinct for superpower dealmaking reflects a hard-nosed realism, backed by the American economy
lines.subject: Niall Ferguson on Trump's foreign policy
lines.why: The column frames the president's approach to Iran as realist and economically backed, which implies the policy has served Americans, though it does not cite a measured reading.

lines.quote: The Yemeni militia is using the culture of its sworn enemies in the renewed fighting with Saudi Arabia
lines.subject: Houthi militia and Saudi Arabia
lines.why: The piece describes Houthi-Saudi fighting and messaging, which is a separate conflict from the US war with Iran and says nothing about its effect on Americans.

lines.quote: killed 241 Americans
lines.subject: American service members killed in the 1983 Beirut barracks attack
lines.why: The line recalls a past death toll from 1983, which is a dated record of the dead and is left unmeasured under the lives rule.

lines.quote: a rabbi recalls how he and two Christian chaplains rushed to aid the wounded and comfort the survivors
lines.subject: rabbi and two Christian chaplains
lines.why: The story is a human-interest frame about chaplains' conduct in 1983, not a reading of the Iran war or of any measured series.

lines.quote: Military reinforcements are heading to the Middle East
lines.subject: US military
lit: Military reinforcements are heading to the Middle East
pointing to a potential attack on Iran
lines.why: Reinforcements pointing toward a possible attack on Iran move the war toward the no-war promise being broken, though no strike has yet happened and no date is given.

lines.quote: millions of Americans have already voted in the midterms
lines.subject: American voters
lit: millions of Americans have already voted
lines.why: The line reports early voting in the midterms, which is not a reading of the Iran war and bears on no measured series of the object.
